name: PRVDAY01.jcl
description:
This JCL job (PRVDAY01) performs the daily provider enrollment processing for the Medicaid Management Information System (MMIS). It enrolls new provider applications into the Provider Master file, then screens and assesses risk for unscreened providers, executing all screening and risk steps only when the enrollment step completes successfully.Key Functionalities:
Executes the provider enrollment program (PRVENR01) using a batch date parameter, reading daily provider applications and updating the Provider Master KSDS file, while writing any enrollment errors to a date-stamped error file with a fixed-block record length of 250 bytes.
If the enrollment step completes with a return code of 0, sorts all unscreened providers (where screening flag = 'U' in position 23) from the Provider Master file by NPI (positions 1–10, ascending) into a temporary work file for downstream processing.
Passes the sorted unscreened provider records to the provider screening program (PRVSCR01), which reads the Provider Master file and writes screening results to a date-stamped output file with a fixed-block record length of 67 bytes.
Executes the provider risk assessment program (PRVRSK01) against the Provider Master file to evaluate and assign risk levels to providers, completing the conditional processing block initiated after successful enrollment.
Runs a final cleanup/dummy step (IEFBR14) conditioned on a non-zero return code to handle any job-level wrap-up processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A batch of new provider enrollment applications exists in the Provider Application Input File (APPINPUT: MMPRV.PROV.APPS.D&DATE) for the current processing date, AND the Provider Master File (PRVMSTR: MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.KSDS) is available, AND the current batch processing date is identified by BATCH_ID=&BATCH_DATE
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Provider Enrollment program (PRVENR01) is executed for the given batch date
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: 1. All provider applications in the daily input file are processed and validated against enrollment business rules, AND 2. Approved provider applications are enrolled into the Provider Master File (PRVMSTR), AND 3. Any rejected or failed provider applications are written to the Provider Application Error File (APPERROR: MMPRV.PROV.ERRORS.D&DATE) with a fixed record length of 250 bytes per rejected application, AND 4. If enrollment processing completes successfully (Return Code = 0), the Provider Application Error File is permanently catalogued and retained for review, AND all downstream steps (provider screening and risk assessment) are permitted to execute, AND 5. If enrollment processing fails (Return Code ≠ 0), the Provider Application Error File is automatically deleted to prevent retention of incomplete error data, AND all downstream provider screening and risk assessment steps are blocked from executing

rules.Rule_Name: STEP010 - PRVENR01 - Daily Provider Enrollment Processing
rules.Rule_Description: This step invokes the Provider Enrollment program (PRVENR01) to process daily provider applications for a given batch date. It reads new provider applications, validates them, enrolls approved providers into the Provider Master File, and captures rejected applications in a date-stamped error file. Successful completion of this step is the gateway condition for all downstream screening and risk assessment processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Provider Master File (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.KSDS) contains provider records with varying Provider Screening Flag (PRV-SCREEN-FLAG) values
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The daily enrollment job extracts provider records from the Provider Master File for screening preparation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Only provider records where the Provider Screening Flag (PRV-SCREEN-FLAG) at position 23 is equal to 'U' (Unscreened) must be selected; all provider records where PRV-SCREEN-FLAG is any value other than 'U' must be excluded from the output

rules.Rule_Name: STEP020 - SORT - Filter Unscreened Providers from Provider Master File
rules.Rule_Description: Only providers who have not yet been screened (PRV-SCREEN-FLAG = 'U') are eligible to be selected from the Provider Master File for the screening process. All already-screened providers are excluded from further processing in this cycle.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A set of provider records has been filtered from the Provider Master File where PRV-SCREEN-FLAG = 'U' (Unscreened)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The filtered unscreened provider records are prepared for the screening process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The selected provider records must be sorted in ascending order by NPI (National Provider Identifier), which occupies positions 1 through 10 of each provider record, and the sorted result must be passed forward to the next processing step

rules.Rule_Name: STEP020 - SORT - Order Unscreened Providers by NPI Ascending
rules.Rule_Description: All unscreened providers selected from the Provider Master File must be arranged in ascending order by their National Provider Identifier (NPI) before being passed to the screening step, ensuring orderly and sequential provider screening processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Provider enrollment (STEP010) has completed successfully, the Provider Master File (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.KSDS) is available with enrolled provider records, and a new date-stamped Provider Screening Results File (MMPRV.SCREEN.RESULTS.D&DATE) is ready to be created for the current processing date
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Provider Screening program (PRVSCR01) is executed and reads provider records from the Provider Master File to evaluate each provider against applicable screening criteria
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screening outcome for each evaluated provider is written as a fixed-length 67-byte record into the Provider Screening Results File; if screening completes successfully the results file is permanently catalogued and retained for compliance and reporting use; if screening fails the results file is deleted to prevent incomplete or partial screening data from being retained

rules.Rule_Description: When provider enrollment completes successfully, the Provider Screening program (PRVSCR01) evaluates enrolled providers against screening criteria by reading from the Provider Master File and records each provider's screening outcome into a date-stamped Screening Results File. The results file is retained only if screening completes successfully; otherwise it is discarded.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The daily provider enrollment step (STEP010) has completed successfully with Return Code = 0, and the Provider Master File (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.KSDS) is available and contains current enrolled provider records updated during the same daily batch run
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Provider Risk Assessment program (PRVRSK01) is executed and reads each provider record from the Provider Master File to evaluate the provider against defined risk criteria
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Each provider in the Provider Master File is assigned a risk level (Limited Risk, Moderate Risk, or High Risk) based on the risk evaluation outcome, and the assigned risk level is written back directly into the provider's record in the Provider Master File (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.KSDS), permanently updating the master record with the current risk classification

rules.Rule_Name: STEP040 - PRVRSK01 - Provider Risk Level Assessment and Assignment
rules.Rule_Description: When daily provider enrollment processing has completed successfully, the Provider Risk Assessment program (PRVRSK01) evaluates all enrolled providers in the Provider Master File and assigns an appropriate risk level (Limited, Moderate, or High) to each provider. This step executes exclusively within the successful enrollment conditional block, ensuring risk assessment is only performed on a valid and up-to-date Provider Master File.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The daily provider enrollment job (PRVDAY01) has executed all applicable steps — Provider Enrollment (STEP010), Unscreened Provider Sort (STEP020), Provider Screening (STEP030), and Provider Risk Assessment (STEP040)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: All prior steps in the daily enrollment cycle have completed successfully with a return code of 0 (no errors in any step)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The daily enrollment cycle completion marker step (STEP099) executes, confirming that the full daily provider enrollment, screening, and risk assessment cycle has completed successfully and the job ends in a successful state; IF any prior step returned a return code greater than 0 (indicating an error in enrollment, screening preparation, screening, or risk assessment), THEN STEP099 is bypassed and the job ends in an error state, signaling that the daily enrollment cycle did not complete fully and requires operational review

rules.Rule_Name: STEP099 - IEFBR14 - Daily Enrollment Cycle Completion Validation
rules.Rule_Description: Determines whether the entire daily provider enrollment cycle — including enrollment, screening preparation, provider screening, and risk assessment — has completed fully and successfully. The job is marked as successfully completed only when all prior steps finish without any errors. If any step in the cycle encountered an error, the completion marker is bypassed and the job ends in an error state.

flow_diagram_code:
flowchart TD
    classDef start fill:#ff6666,color:#fff
    classDef process fill:#6699ff,color:#fff
    classDef decision fill:#ffcc00,color:#000
    classDef datasource fill:#66ff66,color:#000
    classDef final fill:#ae74de,color:#fff
    classDef success fill:#22c55e,color:#fff
    classDef error fill:#ef4444,color:#fff

    START([Job Start
Provider Enrollment & Screening Batch]):::start

    %% ── Job Steps ──────────────────────────────────────────
    STEP010[STEP010 - PRVENR01
Provider Enrollment Processing]:::process
    STEP010_COND{STEP010 Return Code = 0?
Enrollment Completed Successfully?}:::decision
    STEP020[STEP020 - SORT Utility
Sort & Filter Unscreened Providers by NPI]:::process
    STEP030[STEP030 - PRVSCR01
Provider Screening Results Processing]:::process
    STEP040[STEP040 - PRVRSK01
Provider Risk Assessment Processing]:::process
    STEP099_COND{Any Prior Step
Return Code Greater Than 0?}:::decision
    STEP099[STEP099 - IEFBR14
End-of-Job Finalization]:::process

    %% ── Datasources ─────────────────────────────────────────
    APP_INPUT[(APP-INPUT-FILE
Provider Application Input File)]:::datasource
    PRV_MASTER[(MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.KSDS
Provider Master File)]:::datasource
    APP_ERROR[(APP-ERROR-FILE
Provider Application Error File)]:::datasource
    SCREEN_OUT[(SCREEN-OUT-FILE
Provider Screening Results File)]:::datasource

    %% ── End Nodes ───────────────────────────────────────────
    END_SUCCESS([Job End
All Steps Completed Successfully]):::success
    END_ERROR([Job End
Processing Errors Detected - Operational Review Required]):::error

    %% ── Main Flow ───────────────────────────────────────────
    START --> STEP010

    %% STEP010 Data Interactions
    APP_INPUT -.->|Read: New Provider Enrollment Applications| STEP010
    PRV_MASTER -.->|Read & Update: Enroll Valid Providers into Master File| STEP010
    STEP010 -.->|Write: Rejected or Failed Applications| APP_ERROR

    %% STEP010 Condition Check
    STEP010 --> STEP010_COND
    STEP010_COND -->|Yes - Enrollment Successful
Proceed to Screening Preparation| STEP020
    STEP010_COND -->|No - Enrollment Failed
Halt All Further Processing| END_ERROR

    %% STEP020 Data Interactions
    PRV_MASTER -.->|Read: Extract Providers with Screening Flag = U
Unscreened Providers Only - Sorted by NPI| STEP020

    %% STEP020 to STEP030
    STEP020 --> STEP030

    %% STEP030 Data Interactions
    PRV_MASTER -.->|Read: Retrieve Provider Details
for Screening Evaluation| STEP030
    STEP030 -.->|Write: Provider Screening Outcomes
Approved / Rejected / Pending Review| SCREEN_OUT

    %% STEP030 to STEP040
    STEP030 --> STEP040

    %% STEP040 Data Interactions
    PRV_MASTER -.->|Read & Update: Assign Provider Risk Levels
Limited / Moderate / High Risk| STEP040

    %% STEP040 to STEP099 Condition
    STEP040 --> STEP099_COND
    STEP099_COND -->|Yes - Errors Detected in Prior Steps
Bypass Finalization| END_ERROR
    STEP099_COND -->|No - All Steps Successful
Proceed to Finalization| STEP099

    STEP099 --> END_SUCCESS
